name: Kumar Anurag
summary:
Sales and Learning & Development professional with 9+ years of experience in retail sales, distribution
management, and sales capability building. Expert in designing and delivering training programs for frontline
sales teams, distributors, and channel partners to boost productivity, product knowledge, and customer
engagement. Skilled in sales enablement, onboarding, product training, SOP development, and field coaching.
Successfully managed 300+ distributor outlets, created training content, conducted classroom and field
sessions, and drove performance improvements. Proficient in developing training modules, induction
programs, sales pitch certifications, and performance workshops. Strong in stakeholder management, key
account handling, promotional execution, and driving revenue growth through capability enhancement.
